Name: model-side-indirect-address
Description: Two full-duplex agents judging addressing themselves. A question that names nobody is taken up by the agent whose model signalled it was addressed; an unclaimed question is left alone; a later direct question is taken up by the other agent. A name-matching regex would have missed all three.

Events.Text: What does the finance side of the house think about that forecast?
Finance would want the downside case modeled before committing to the hiring plan.
And from the product side, how does that land?
Product can absorb it if the launch slips by one sprint.
